store.description: A full 3D driving simulator for Windows 12. Race 3 rivals on a mountain circuit or free-roam an open world with lakes, forests, ramps and boost rings. Detailed sports car, chase camera, engine audio and boost — WASD to drive, Space for boost.
features: Real-time 3D open world: mountains, lake, forests, rocks and ramps
Two modes: 3-lap Circuit Race vs 3 AI rivals, and open Free Roam
Detailed sports car: cabin, spoiler, headlights, spinning steered wheels
Arcade physics with drift, off-road slowdown, jumps and boost
Chase camera, minimap, engine audio, persistent best lap and top speed
WASD / arrows to drive, Space for boost, R to reset
